components.name: Chart/Candlestick
components.description: Price movement per period: body = open → close, wick = high → low. Up = dataviz/positive, Down = dataviz/negative (never series colours). Volume adds bars under the plot at layer opacity 40%. Mobile: pinch-zoom with a 1-week default window; pair with Chart/Range brush on long series. React: <CandlestickChart data={[{ t, o, h, l, c, v? }]} volume? />
